src/lib/desk-sections.ts and src/components/desk/section-tabs*.tsx add role-filtered tabs through small layouts (Schedule: Dispatch board, Jobs, Driver view; Equipment: Inventory, Parts, Purchases, Purchase orders; Money: Billing, Revenue, Fleet, Reports, Business overview). No address moved; DESK_NAV_ALIASES keeps the right entry highlighted, proven for every alias in tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts and tests/w8-section-tabs.test.tsx.

src/app/desk/more/page.tsx lists Suppliers, Growth signals, Launch list, System health, Privacy requests and Activity through deskMoreLinks, filtered by role on the server (staff see Activity only); the preview storage check is in neither the menu, the tabs nor More and still returns not-found outside test storage. Covered by tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts and tests/w8-section-tabs.test.tsx.

scripts/check-owner-wording.mjs runs with npm run lint (and in CI's static job): banned phrases with plain replacements on owner screen text and To do text, an allowlist that requires a written reason, and 18 hard words fixed (jurisdiction, remit/remittance, a raw status code). scripts/check-owner-wording.test.mjs is part of check:preflight.

tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts checks every menu entry, tab and More link for owner, admin and staff against the e2e route inventory (/desk/more was added); the new page is also in the browser accessibility inventory.

src/domains/tax/filing-attention.ts works out each closed period's total with the same filing packet the return page uses and src/domains/exceptions/rules.ts titles the To do "File and pay $X on SUTS by <date>" or "File a $0 return on SUTS by <date>", adding "(overdue)" after the legal date; it opens the return. tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts (real Postgres) proves the amount, the $0 case, the overdue wording and that a filed return leaves the list.

src/domains/tax/filing-reminders.ts now emails every business day once a return is past its legal deadline (the before-due days stay the owner-editable 7 and 2, and the due day stays). tests/tax-filing-reminders-integration.test.ts asserts the new daily rule.

The return page's form is now "I filed and paid it": date paid and confirmation number, with filed date and a different amount in an optional section; markPeriodFiled defaults the filed date to the paid date and the amount to the calculated amount, still refuses a different amount without a reason and a blank confirmation number, locks the return and marks the equipment use tax filed. Real-Postgres tests in tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts and the existing tax-filing-finalization and tax-return-actions suites.

collectSystemIssueInputs compares each active account's filing calendar with its saved periods and raises the high TAX_PERIOD_MISSING issue (rendered and linked to the returns list) when a closed period has no return, clearing it once the rows exist. Real-Postgres test in tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts and tests/system-issue-sweep-integration.test.ts.
